statements.title: S1: distance 1, every check run

statements.title: S2: a chain of three, every check run
S3: the same chain, distance only
S4: the same chain from the receiver's records, the path in Electrum form, distance only
S5: an uneven diamond: longest path 3, shortest 1
S6: one input whose source is not held, every check run
S7: the same from the receiver's records, distance only
S8: the payment is itself an anchor, its path in Electrum form
S9: a signature by the wrong key, distance only
S10: a Merkle path above the header source's tip: not checked, the walk goes on
statements.inputs: the header source is the table cut at its tip, height 950001.

statements.title: S11: a lock time given as a time, below the median time past
statements.inputs: the header source is the table plus the header at height 950000 given below it.

statements.title: S12: the same, without a header the median time past needs: left out
S13: a script the maker cannot evaluate: left out, validation partial
S14: a pair off the anchor's own path that decodes as a transaction: the anchor holds
S15: S6 as a BEEF V2 that carries Z4 by txid only
S16: a payment that is a confiscation transaction: left out, validation none
